title: 이지유오 핫키설정법좀갈켜주세여
bodyHtml:
onhotkey z ctrl
goto heal

heal:

finditem ZLF

if #FINDBAGID <> #CONTID
stop

set #LOBJECTID #FINDID
event macro 17 0
target 1s
event macro 23 0

stop


요렇게했는데   핫키가안되어가지구....어떻게해야되나여
bodyText: onhotkey z ctrl goto heal heal: finditem ZLF if #FINDBAGID <> #CONTID stop set #LOBJECTID #FINDID event macro 17 0 target 1s event macro 23 0 stop 요렇게했는데   핫키가안되어가지구....어떻게해야되나여
